context: A boss mentors his manager about leadership qualities
purpose: Teach: 外見/プライド/資質/モラル/狩り/シンボル/青空/マスク

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 君も来月から課長だな。リーダーの資質というのは、外見だけで判断できるものじゃないぞ。
lines.en: You'll be section chief next month. A leader's qualities can't be judged by appearance alone.
lines.style: Calm, paternal, weighty mentor tone with measured pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。正直、自分にその資質があるのか、まだ自信が持てません。
lines.en: Yes. Honestly, I'm still not sure I have what it takes.
lines.style: Humble, slightly hesitant, junior manager confiding upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プライドが高い奴ほど、部下のモラルを平気で踏みにじる。それでは組織は持たない。
lines.en: The more arrogant the type, the more easily they trample their subordinates' morale. An organization won't survive that.
lines.style: Stern, instructive, drawing on hard-earned wisdom.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど…失敗した部下を犯人狩りのように追い詰めるのは、結局自分のプライドを守ってるだけなんですね。
lines.en: I see... cornering subordinates who fail like you're on a manhunt is really just protecting your own pride.
lines.style: Reflective, connecting the dots back to the boss's point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そういうことだ。上司は、部下にとって信頼のシンボルでなければならん。
lines.en: That's it. A boss must be a symbol of trust to those under him.
lines.style: Firm, declarative, emphasizing a core principle clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 信頼のシンボル…重い言葉ですね。マスクで本心を隠したような上司には、誰もついて来ない。
lines.en: A symbol of trust... heavy words. Nobody follows a boss who hides his true feelings behind a mask.
lines.style: Earnest, internalizing, voice softening with realization.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: わかってきたな。週末は少し休め。青空でも見上げて、頭を空っぽにしてこい。
lines.en: You're getting it. Take some rest this weekend. Look up at the blue sky and empty your head for a while.
lines.style: Warm, paternal shift, easing the lesson with practical advice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。肝に銘じます。信頼される課長を目指して、一歩ずつやっていきます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll engrave it on my heart. I'll work step by step toward being a trusted section chief.
lines.style: Resolved, grateful, voice steady with newfound conviction.
